'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Crimea attacks]]
***[[2022 Crimean Bridge explosion]]
****A [[Russia]]n [[Judiciary of Russia|court]] sentences eight people to [[Life imprisonment in Russia|life imprisonment]] for [[Terrorism in Russia|terrorism]] after a [[Car bomb|truck bomb]] attack on the [[Crimean Bridge]] in [[Crimea]] killed five people in October 2022. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/russia-convicts-and-hands-life-sentences-to-8-people-over-attack-on-a-key-bridge-to-crimea/ar-AA1RfMjs (MSN)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli occupation of the West Bank]]
***The [[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|military]] and [[Israel Police|police]] say they are reviewing a raid in [[Jenin]], [[West Bank]], in which forces fatally shot two [[Palestinians]] who had exited a surrounded building after a prolonged surrender procedure. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/11/27/israeli-army-is-reviewing-the-filmed-shootings-of-two-palestinians-who-had-surrended_6747911_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Three [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|policemen]] are killed in a shooting attack by unknown militants with [[assault rifle]]s on a roadside checkpoint in [[Hangu District, Pakistan|Hangu District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/militants-kill-3-police-officers-attack-checkpoint-northwest-127922767 (AP via ABC News)]

[https://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-afghanistan-border-attack-chinese-nationals-death-gold-mining-taliban/33607228.html (Radio Free Europe)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Green economy policies in Canada]], [[Anti-environmentalism]]
**[[Canada|Canadian]] [[Prime Minister of Canada|prime minister]] [[Mark Carney]] and [[Alberta]] [[Premier of Alberta|premier]] [[Danielle Smith]] sign an agreement removing planned [[Government of Canada|federal]] [[Emissions trading|emissions caps]] and eases [[Renewable energy in Canada|clean-energy]] rules in exchange for strengthened provincial [[Carbon pricing in Canada|carbon pricing]] and support for [[Carbon capture and storage|carbon-capture]] projects, while also committing to enable a privately financed [[Petroleum industry in Canada|oil]] [[Pipelines in Canada|pipeline]] to [[British Columbia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/canada-drops-emissions-cap-oil-gas-sector-agreement-with-alberta-2025-11-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Ditwah]]
***More than 40 people are killed, and 21 others are missing after [[landslide]]s caused by heavy rains hit [[Sri Lanka]], mainly between [[Badulla]] and [[Nuwara Eliya]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sri-lanka-weather-landslides-floods-ef3a2354448a7ec58cfe4ac5d8f750d1 (AP)]
**[[Cyclone Senyar]]
***The death toll from flooding in [[Songkhla province]], [[Thailand]], rises to 104. [https://www.thaipost.net/general-news/904429/ (''Thai Post'')]
***Flooding on [[Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]], kills 49 people, leaves 67 others missing, and submerges over 2,000 buildings, with many of the worst-affected areas still unreachable a day after Cyclone Seynar's landfall. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/indonesia-north-sumatra-jakarta-b2873472.html (''The Independent'')]
*Nineteen people are killed after heavy winds cause a [[riverboat]] to capsize on [[Lake Mai-Ndombe]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-19-people-die-congo-boat-accident-2025-11-29/ (Reuters)]
*Eleven people are killed and two more are injured in [[Kunming]], [[China]], when a train hits a group of railway maintenance workers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/27/train-collision-in-china-kills-11-railway-maintenance-workers-reports (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Iran relations]]
**[[2024 Iranian operations inside Australia]]
***[[Australia]] adds [[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] to its [[List of organisations designated as terrorist by Australia|list of terrorist organisations]] as a [[state-sponsored terrorism|state sponsor]] due to its role in orchestrating and executing [[Terrorism in Australia|terrorist attacks in Australia]] last year. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-11-28/iran-condemns-australia-listing-irgc-as-sponsor-of-terrorism/106075808 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**The [[Moldova]]n [[Parliament of Moldova|parliament]] votes to close a [[Russia]]n [[cultural center]], citing security concerns and recent Russian [[Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|drone incursions]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/moldovan-parliament-votes-close-russian-cultural-centre-2025-11-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Poland–Russia relations]]
**Russia orders [[Poland]] to close its [[consulate]] in [[Irkutsk]] in response to Poland's closure of the Russian consulate in [[Gdańsk]] following a [[Rail transport in Poland|railway]] explosion earlier this month that Poland attributes to Russian involvement. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-close-polish-consulate-siberia-row-over-railway-sabotage-2025-11-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 deployment of federal forces in the United States]]
**[[2025 Washington, D.C., National Guard shooting]]
***One of two [[U.S.]] [[US National Guard|National Guard]] troops who were shot in [[Washington, D.C.]], a day earlier dies. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwyx4y6007lo (BBC News)]
*[[2022 Peruvian self-coup attempt]]
**The [[Peru]]vian [[Supreme Court of Peru|Supreme Court]] sentences former [[President of Peru|president]] [[Pedro Castillo]] to 11 and a half years in prison for [[criminal conspiracy]] when he tried to dissolve [[Congress of the Republic of Peru|Congress]] and attempted a [[self-coup]] in 2022. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-former-president-pedro-castillo-conspiracy-af153bb322fab6329cd65e1c32a2c881 (AP)]
*[[Koldo Case]]
**The [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Supreme Court of Spain|Supreme Court]] orders former [[Ministry of Development (Spain)|transport minister]] and former deputy leader of the ruling [[PSOE]] [[José Luis Ábalos]] and ex-adviser Koldo García into [[pre-trial detention]] without [[bail]] on charges linked to alleged [[Kickback (finance)|kickbacks]] in [[Government procurement in the European Union|public procurement]], while also naming former [[Congress of Deputies|lawmaker]] [[Santos Cerdán]] as a suspect. [https://www.gulf-times.com/article/715964/international/ex-ally-of-spanish-pm-arrested-in-graft-probe (AFP via ''Gulf Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état]]
**The [[Guinea-Bissau|Bissau-Guinean]] [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of the People (Guinea-Bissau)|military]] installs General [[Horta Inta-A Na Man]] as interim leader for one year, while [[President of Guinea-Bissau|President]] [[Umaro Sissoco Embaló]] is flown to [[Senegal]], with [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] candidate [[Fernando Dias da Costa]] alleging the coup was orchestrated to block the release of the [[2025 Guinea-Bissau general election|election]] results he claims to have won. [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2025/11/guinea-bissau-president-is-in-senegal-after-coup-senegalese-govt/ (AFP via ''Vanguard'')]
*[[2025 Vincentian general election]]
**[[New Democratic Party (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines)|NDP]] leader [[Godwin Friday]] is projected to become the next [[List of prime ministers of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines|prime minister]] of [[Saint Vincent and the Grenadines]], ending 24 years of [[Unity Labour Party|ULP]] government under the premiership of [[Ralph Gonsalves]]. [https://wicnews.com/saint-vincent-grenadines/godwin-friday-wins-1st-term-as-st-vincent-and-the-grenadines-prime-minister (''WIC News'')]
*[[Conscription in France]]
**[[France|French]] [[President of France|president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces the revival of [[voluntary military]] [[military service|service]] for 18 and 19-year-olds to begin in [[2026]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/france-plans-to-revive-voluntary-military-service-in-2026/a-74931355 (DW)]
*[[Human rights in Tunisia]]
**[[Tunisia]] releases opposition lawyer and journalist [[Sonia Dahmani]] after serving half of her prison sentence for remarks deemed to be ''[[lèse-majesté]]''. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisia-frees-prominent-lawyer-sonia-dahmani-critic-president-2025-11-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Alejandro Gertz Manero]] resigns as [[Attorney General of Mexico|Attorney General]] of [[Mexico]], citing an invitation from [[President of Mexico|President]] [[Claudia Sheinbaum]] to serve as ambassador to an unspecified country. His departure comes amid scrutiny over his role in overseeing multiple prominent investigations, the most recent being the [[Miss Universe 2025]] controversy involving its co-owner, Rubén Rocha, who has been accused of cooperating in [[drug trafficking|drug]], fuel, and [[arms trade|weapons trafficking]] in Mexico. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-11-28/sheinbaum-pushes-attorney-general-out-amid-fuel-smuggling-probe (''Bloomberg'')] [https://mvsnoticias.com/nacional/2025/11/27/gertz-manero-dejo-de-ser-confiable-el-conflicto-con-sheinbaum-que-acelera-su-salida-de-fgr-721682.html (MVS <small>in Spanish</small>)]
